text: Class [Lat. classis ]: Ger. Klass ; Fr. classe ; Ital. classe . The indefinite number of individual objects or cases characterized by the possession by each of a certain quantum of definite marks. The class, for logical purposes, is a wider and more arbitrary notion than the class as recognized in special scientific researches. ( R.A. )
